breakdown.reason: The generated specification does not address the Fanning-to-Darcy friction factor conversion at all. It merely asks about fluid velocity, completely ignoring the critical inconsistency of using the Fanning friction factor (f_F=0.005) directly in the Darcy-Weisbach equation without converting to the Darcy friction factor (f_D = 4 × f_F = 0.02).
